answer: A farm faking 141 aliases needs 141 separate firing histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Potter guild membership with kiln firing history is the check: firing histories filed with one guild chapter for years. The ridge check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The saffron record is public, the atlas cost is per identity, and 141 aliases cost 141 times one honest seat.
